overview_description.description: Turpal is a travel technology company that provides software and digital solutions for tour operators, travel agencies, and attraction providers. The platform supports online booking management, inventory distribution, and reservation processing for travel experiences and activities. Its services are designed to help travel businesses manage operations, connect with distribution channels, and streamline customer booking workflows across web and mobile platforms.
